title: Concept: Regular expression compiled from input in javascript — review required
description: In javascript, new RegExp() builds a matcher from a runtime string. JavaScript has no match timeout, so a pattern like (a+)+$ against a long non-matching string pins the thread for seconds or minutes. Search filters, routing rules and validation helpers are the usual places where request text becomes a pattern.
applicability: javascript services that build matchers from request parameters or configuration.
